title: SAP India Targets 2 Million People for AI Skilling by 2030
script:
SAP India just set a target to train two million people in AI by twenty thirty.
The program aims to bridge the growing digital skills gap across the Indian workforce.
Students, educators, and professionals will gain access to specialized digital learning pathways and certifications.
Participants will learn practical machine learning concepts through hands-on cloud software modules.
This massive rollout addresses the rising demand for certified technology talent in local enterprises.
Would your career benefit from free professional training?
